_comment: Hand-picked comparable companies, one stated reason per name.
Peers are otherwise derived from EDGAR's SIC code, a 1970s taxonomy that puts
Socket Mobile in Apple's bucket and leaves Microsoft out of it. A set listed
here replaces the automatic one outright and is marked vetted; anything not
listed falls back to SIC and is marked unvetted in the response.
Edit freely — the file is read per request, so changes need no restart.

peers.reason: Platform-scale software and services, competing for the same consumer and enterprise wallet
Mobile OS competitor and the largest single payer into Apple's services line
Premium consumer-hardware franchise with an attached content and services business
Personal-computing hardware at scale — the closest listed peer inside Apple's own SIC bucket
PC and peripherals volume, useful as the low-margin end of the hardware comparison
Supplies the modem and sits in Apple's silicon supply chain
Hyperscale cloud and the directly competing productivity suite
AWS is the cloud share leader Azure is measured against
Enterprise software and database, now also selling AI capacity
Enterprise SaaS margin and growth benchmark
The only other merchant vendor of datacentre training and inference GPUs
Custom accelerators and networking silicon — the substitution path for large buyers
Incumbent datacentre compute, and the counterfactual for share loss
Fabricates the parts; its utilisation is the supply ceiling on the whole set
